title: Exciting News from AMC Global Media's New York Comic Con Panels
summary: We took over the Main Stage at New York Comic Con to present a compelling lineup of panels for must-see new series Kill Jackie and YAGA and new seasons of returning fan favorites Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches and The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon.
body_markdown:
Today, AMC Global Media took over the Main Stage at New York Comic Con to present a compelling lineup of panels for its must-see new series *Kill Jackie* and *YAGA* and new seasons of returning fan favorites *Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches* and *The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon* .


Kicking off the session was a conversation with Oscar, BAFTA, and Tony Award-winning actress Catherine Zeta-Jones ( *Chicago* , *Wednesday* ), showrunner, writer and executive producer Tom Butterworth and executive producer Peter Lawson about the new AMC+ revenge thriller, *Kill Jackie* . Moderated by Collider’s Perri Nemiroff, the trio discussed the making of the series, shared exclusive clips and treated the audience to a sneak peek of an upcoming episode. Watch the sneak peek below:


During the *YAGA* panel that followed, TV Guide Magazine and TV Insider’s Damian Holbrook moderated a lively exploration of the series with executive producer and star Carrie-Anne Moss ( *The Matrix* , *Memento* ), showrunner, writer and executive producer Kat Sandler, and executive producer Mackenzie Donaldson. The panelists shared insights into the creation and production of the witchy new AMC+ series, premiering on Friday, October 23, and previewed new scenes for attendees. Watch preview clips #1 and #2 below:


Holbrook then welcomed to the stage the producers and stars of *Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches: Salem Coven* , including Alexandra Daddario, Harry Hamlin, Tongayi Chirisa, Betsy Brandt and Eliza Scanlen, co-showrunners and executive producers Esta Spalding and Tom Schnauz, and executive producer Mark Johnson, who previewed the series' anticipated third season with an exclusive first look and teaser trailer and announced **the season premiere date of Wednesday, December 30** . Watch the teaser trailer below:


To end the afternoon, *The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon* stars and executive producers Norman Reedus and Melissa McBride took the stage with showrunner and executive producer David Zabel and executive producer Scott M. Gimple for a panel moderated by actor, writer, producer Clarke Wolfe. The cast and creative team previewed the fourth and final season, premiering in February, with never-before-seen footage, and new teaser trailer as part of a panel that celebrated the incredible 15-year journey of fan favorite characters Daryl (Reedus) and Carol (McBride).
